subject: Thanks for the help with my headphones
body:
Hi there,

I just wanted to write in about the service I got at your West Lake store last weekend. I'd been having trouble with a pair of wireless headphones I bought a few months back — they kept cutting out on one side — and honestly I went in expecting a hassle.

The person who helped me (I'm sorry, I didn't catch his name, but he was working the electronics counter on Saturday afternoon) took the time to actually listen to what was going wrong. He tried them himself, asked a couple of questions about when it happened, and then walked me through what my options were without any pressure. He even showed me how to reset them properly, which I hadn't known about.

It's a small thing, but it made a difference to me. I've been back to using them all week and so far so good. Please pass along my thanks if you can.

Best,
Daniel
